Compare a discount with your actual need, not the original price.

Rytm will read only notifications from banking apps (monobank, PUMB, Privat24 and others) to suggest adding a transaction with the amount and merchant.

• Other apps' notifications are never read.
• The text is parsed on this phone only — never sent anywhere or stored.
• A transaction is saved only by your action: after checking it in the form, or by tapping a category button in the notification itself (that can be undone for 10 minutes).
